keys.title: Local Voice Layer

keys.consentGateDesc: Client explicitly consents to on-device audio transcription. Audio is never stored; the text transcript is only saved to the encrypted vault if you press Save.
keys.noClients: No clients found. Add one in the Clients module first.
keys.englishTranslationDesc: Runs a second pass over every clip. Roughly doubles the work — leave off unless you need it.
keys.audioDropped: s of audio was dropped to keep the session responsive.
keys.liveFeedDesc: Original preserved for accuracy disputes. Tap text to inline-edit.
keys.sessionEmpty: Session empty. Audio is discarded immediately post-transcription.
